_comment: Where each issuer publishes its complete register, and how to read it.
The dumps themselves are never committed: half a gigabyte compressed for
one country, renewed monthly, and published under the issuer's own terms.
What is committed is this description, so that anyone can reproduce a
sweep from the same source the maintainers used.

registers.notes: Every company on the live register. The 2026-08-01 file carries 5695465 of them, all on exactly eight characters. Dissolved companies are absent, so a prefix with no row is not thereby invalid.

Every legal unit the SIREN directory has ever registered, active and ceased alike, 29922486 of them in the 2026-08-01 stock. Ceased units are kept, which is what makes the sweep cover identifiers that outlive their company.

Every establishment the SIRET directory has ever registered, 43896818 of them in the 2026-08-01 stock. One entry is refused and is expected to be: 58209045200015 satisfies neither the Luhn check nor the La Poste derogation, and no source documents a derogation for the company holding it, an ordinary limited company registered in 1958. It reads as a single bad record among forty four million rather than a rule, and inventing an exception for one number would be inventing a rule with no source.
